column1: # Prewarm seed list (shipped in the app, next to shader_map.tsv). Rows: S<TAB>shader key<TAB>stage / R<TAB>render pipeline key (pso_skey hex) / C<TAB>compute shader key.

# Recorded on an iPhone 18 Pro Max from the owner's play on release 1 (5b302cd0, chain ac67cb709fa0, update 1.4.1 v393216), Ultrawide on (DM_MOD_ULTRAWIDE=1), no edge smoothing, with no list present (a fresh install: everything built on the spot): Documents/pso_user.tsv after that first start, boot, the owner's save and about 3 minutes of play (9,700 frames), 15895 rows: 15164 S, 723 R, 8 C.

# The S rows are the libraries its program creation and draws loaded (15164 of the shader map's 27984); the R rows are the render pipelines its draws built, 3 frames over 100 ms on that first start (up to 932 ms). Row order = first-use order; do not sort. Checked with dm/tools/pso_seed.py check.

# Ultrawide is a patch of main alone (the scene's aspect and the HUD layout's size: no RomFS file, no shader, no render target size or format), so these rows name the same pipelines with it off; the pipeline key holds no picture size.
